topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: The card was simple, too simple, just a few words scrawled in a handwriting I once knew by heart. The gift, an object I can't quite place, wrapped in paper that feels wrong, too bright, too cheerful. I clutch it, fingers trembling, as if the weight of it might crush me. Why now? After all these years, the echo of those walls, the silence of the empty desks, the way the clock never seems to move as fast as it should. I can't bear to open it, to face whatever piece of the past has been sent back to me. The world outside the window blurs, and for a moment, it feels like I can't breathe.
